Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layergroup

Class CreateLayerGroupRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layergroup.CreateLayerGroupRequest
public class CreateLayerGroupRequest extends Object
Request DTO for POST /rest/layergroups or POST /rest/workspaces/{ws}/layergroups.

Use builder(String) to create instances.

Note: the abstract field is sent as "abstract" on POST/PUT (not as the "abstractTxt" key returned in GET responses).
